content: I will create a typed `AppProvider
` component in `components/AppProvider.tsx` using the `use client` directive to handle client-side context.
Then, I will remove the original JavaScript version.
I will create the
`app/layout.tsx` file to replace `_app.js` and `_document.js`. This layout will
handle the global configuration, including the `Inter` font, `AppProvider` for state management, and the common header
and footer structure, while importing the global styles.
I will create the `app/page.tsx` file to replace `index.js`. This file will utilize
an async component to fetch posts and retrieve headers server-side, incorporating proper types and ensuring compatibility with the latest Next.
js version by awaiting the `headers()` function.
I will create the `app/blog/page.tsx` file
to replace `blog/index.js`. This file will utilize an async component to fetch posts with revalidation, implementing
proper types and replacing the `router.push` navigation with the more efficient `Link` component.
I will create a `BackButton` component in `components/BackButton.tsx` that utilizes the `use client` directive and
`useRouter` hook for client-side navigation. Then, I will generate the `app/blog/[id]/
page.tsx` file, implementing asynchronous data fetching, static parameter generation, and metadata handling, ensuring I await the `params
` promise as required by the latest Next.js version.
I will create the `app/api/posts/route.ts` file to handle GET and
POST requests, using `NextResponse` for JSON responses and adhering to the App Router's exported function pattern. Then, I
will create `app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts` to handle GET, PUT, and DELETE requests for
individual posts, ensuring I await the `params` promise as required by the latest Next.js version.
I will create the `app/not-found.tsx` file to
handle 404 errors with a custom UI and metadata. Then, I will create `app/error.tsx
` as a client component to handle runtime errors, providing a user-friendly error message and a reset functionality.
I will delete
the `pages/` directory to complete the migration to the App Router. After removing the directory, I will run the build
process to verify that the migration was successful and that the application builds without errors.
